## Description

WhatsApp Business adapter in Notifications: approved templates in English, Arabic and Hindi (confirmation, reminder, reschedule link, running late, balance due, portal update), opt-in records per patient/channel, delivery/read status, one-tap reschedule link into the portal, "doctor running 20 min late" broadcast to today's affected patients. Admin screen for templates/opt-ins/status (design first).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Only approved templates are sent; messages carry no clinical details (validation).
- [ ] **AC2.** Messages are sent only with a WhatsApp opt-in receipt; opt-out via reply is honoured.
- [ ] **AC3.** Delivery status updates the notification record; failures fall back to SMS if configured.
- [ ] **AC4.** Running-late broadcast reaches only patients booked with that doctor today and is audited.
- [ ] **AC5.** Patient confirmations via WhatsApp count toward the ≥ 30 % metric (exit gate 4).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
